parents.subject: LU-12669 ec: fix degraded read page leak and short read

commit.subject: LU-20708 llite: finish read fault failover for EC and FLR
commit.message:
LU-20708 llite: finish read fault failover for EC and FLR

osc_io_iter_init() returns -EAGAIN for a non-delayed CIT_READ on an
OSC whose import is not healthy, so the read moves to another mirror,
or for EC, once every mirror was tried, is rebuilt from parity.  A
read fault is non-delayed too, and since "llite: rebuild faulting EC
pages from parity" restarts the same way, but it would still get -EIO
from an inactive OSC, which ll_fault() returns as SIGBUS.  So mmap
reads of an FLR or EC file would fail while one of its OSTs is
deactivated or unreachable, though read(2) of the same file works.
Return -EAGAIN for CIT_FAULT as for CIT_READ.

The rebuild of a faulting EC page would also not always complete:
- the retried fault found the rebuilt page only through the fast
  fault path, so with fast_read off, without the layout lock, or on
  a busy folio lock, its CIT_FAULT lock enqueue, which does not match
  the EC placeholder lock, would wait for the OST after the rebuild.
  A fault that switches to CIT_EC_RD with its page already Uptodate
  in the page cache now takes it from there with filemap_fault(),
  covered by the placeholder lock, before it rebuilds the page;
- the aligned 1MiB read around the page could fail as a whole, e.g.
  on the stale parity of another component, and leave the page itself
  unbuilt.  The page is now rebuilt by itself first, and the rest of
  the 1MiB only after that, whose failure leaves those pages to their
  own faults;
- the EC switch was reported as -ENODATA, which a released file whose
  restore cannot be registered also returns, so such a fault would
  try a parity rebuild before its SIGBUS.  ll_fault_io_init() now
  reports the switch separately.
A fault interrupted by a signal in the mirror rounds faults again
rather than get SIGBUS, and the debug message after a fault no longer
reads the VMA, which may be gone once the mmap lock was dropped.

Add sanity-flr test_33d and sanity-ec test_49g: mmap reads of an FLR
file with each mirror's OST deactivated, and of an EC file with a data
OST deactivated, and run sanity-ec test_41o also with fast_read off.
